items.docs:
Build the deep link to the Databricks Spark UI for a job run.

Thin pass-through to ``DatabricksJobService.resolve_spark_ui``; that
method does the lookup → cred-resolve → runs/get → URL-compose flow
and maps the expected failure modes to ``state`` values on the
always-200 response.

info.name: Get the static task list for a Databricks job

items.docs:
Return every task defined on the job's workflow DAG (regardless
of whether the task has been run or has an Auto Tune
recommendation). Sourced from ``dbx_job_tasks_inventory``.

The Auto Tune drawer DAG and the overview "Tasks" tile use this as
the authoritative task list so they don't depend on the recs feed
or task-runs windowing for the denominator.

info.name: Get Databricks auto right-sizing recommendations for a job

params.name: instance_id
params.description: Tenant instance ID (workspace) to scope the lookup

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Optional Databricks workspace_id to scope queries to a specific workspace within the tenant's Databricks account. Defends against cross-workspace job_id collisions. When None, falls back to (instance_id, entity_id) lookup.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the window the savings figures are summed over. Matches the shape of /auto-tune/savings-trends so the FE's date-range picker can drive both the chart and this drawer consistently. Defaults to 30 days before end_date when omitted.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the savings window (inclusive). Defaults to today (UTC) when omitted.

items.docs:
Return rows from `dbx_auto_recommendation` scoped to this job.

Each row carries ``auto_tune_mode`` projected via LEFT JOIN on
``databricks_auto_tune_configuration`` (PRD §6 Option A — single
source of truth for the toggle position) plus a server-computed
``monthly_savings_usd``.

Each item also carries ``depends_on`` (upstream task DAG edges from
``dbx_job_tasks_inventory.depends_on_keys``) and
``latest_action_event_type`` (most recent audit event_type per
task_key — drives the FE status pill).

info.name: Toggle auto-tune on/off for a job's recommendation

params.name: instance_id
params.description: Tenant instance ID (workspace) the job runs in

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Optional Databricks workspace_id to scope queries to a specific workspace within the tenant's Databricks account. Defends against cross-workspace job_id collisions. When None, falls back to (instance_id, entity_id) lookup.

params.name: task_key
params.description: Task key when toggling a per-task recommendation. Empty string for job-level recommendations (default).

params.name: force
params.description: Only meaningful for sync rollback (disable on an applied rec). When the job has active runs, force=true cancels them before reverting the cluster config. Defaults to false; the BE returns rollback.needs_confirmation=true and the FE shows an interstitial.

items.docs:
Enable or disable auto-tune for a recommendation.

Three flows behind one endpoint (v2.5 §15):

1. **Enable** — write APPLY_REQUESTED + flip config to enabled.
   Worker picks up async and calls Databricks.
2. **Disable when never applied** — fast-path. Write APPLY_REQUESTED
   (mode=disable) + flip the per-role cfg rows to disabled. No
   Databricks call needed.
3. **Disable when previously APPLIED** — sync rollback.
   BE preflight → optionally cancel active runs (with ``force=true``)
   → POS

info.name: Page-level Auto Tune status for a job

params.name: instance_id
params.description: Tenant instance ID (workspace) the job runs in

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Optional Databricks workspace_id to scope queries to a specific workspace within the tenant's Databricks account. Defends against cross-workspace job_id collisions. When None, falls back to (instance_id, entity_id) lookup.

items.docs:
Read-only status endpoint consumed by the Auto Tune tab on mount.

Aggregates ``auto_tune_mode`` across every (entity_id, task_key) row
for this job: master is "enabled" if ANY task is enabled. Surfaces a
job-level preflight result so the FE can disable the master Switch
when the SP can't act on the workspace, with the exact actionable
message we'd show on a real toggle attempt. Also returns
``recommendation_count`` so the FE can gate the Auto Tune tab.

info.name: Paginated Auto Tune audit history for a job

params.name: instance_id
params.description: Tenant instance ID (workspace) the job runs in

params.name: event_types
params.description: Comma-separated list of event_type values to include (APPLY_REQUESTED, APPLIED, FAILED). Empty/omitted = all.

params.name: period
params.description: Look-back window in days. Excludes audit rows whose ``change_timestamp`` is older than now - period days.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Optional Databricks workspace_id to scope queries to a specific workspace within the tenant's Databricks account. Defends against cross-workspace job_id collisions. When None, falls back to (instance_id, entity_id) lookup.

items.docs:
Read-only audit history for the Auto Tune tab.

Returns the most-recent events first. Each row carries
``event_message`` composed server-side from event_type + mode + actor
+ payload via ``DBX_AUTO_TUNE_EVENT_UI_MAPPING`` so the FE renders
one string verbatim.

User resolution is manual (PR #5070 hasn't merged): we batch-load
``altimate_users`` rows for the non-null ``changed_by`` ids on the
page and attach ``changed_by_name`` before serialization.
